# J.P. Creative Hub

> J.P. Creative Hub LLC is a small California language practice run by Juan Carlos Alvarez and Pang, offering English–Hmong interpreting, translation, proofreading, and voice work, with Spanish on request.

J.P. Creative Hub (often just "JP Creative Hub") is two people, one practice. Pang is the lead interpreter and translator, with nearly a decade of professional English–Hmong work and a much earlier start interpreting for the Hmong community while still young. Juan Carlos brings more than twenty years of digital media, multilingual work, and technical support. The goal is simple: meaning, kept intact.

## Services

- Interpreting: English to Hmong and Hmong to English, for medical, legal, and educational settings, events, and meetings. Over-the-phone (OPI) and video remote (VRI) interpreting are preferred; in person depending on availability and location. Spanish can be accommodated on request.
- Translation: print (single-page flyers, magazines, books, forms), digital (websites, training modules), and business material (customer service call scripts, utility customer text alerts). The aim is to keep the original intent and tone, not just the words.
- Proofreading: Hmong proofreading done by hand, since reliable automated tools for Hmong are few. We check spelling, grammar, tone, consistency, and cultural fit.
- Voice: voiceovers for commercials, videos, and audiobooks, in a range of styles.
- Design: graphic design and videography when a language project needs a visual side.

## Languages

- English
- Hmong
- Spanish (on request)

## How to request interpreting or a quote

Tell us what you need: the language pair, the setting, whether it is phone, video, or in person, and the date and time or the document and deadline.

- Email: info@jpcreatives.cc
